messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired -> SEV2: embeddings-eu queue 95th latency >10s. Affected: Hosted API (eu-west). Pager: PD#E-7832. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/embeddings-queue
sasha: acked :raised_hand: I'm taking first triage. looking at queue depth and worker pods.
sasha: quick check: queue backlog ~42k. workers at 2/10 ready, CPU usage low. `kubectl get hpa -n inference` shows desired 10 but current 2.
sasha: logs show metrics-exporter pod OOMKilled repeatedly -> HPA not receiving metrics. `kubectl logs metrics-exporter-7f8b` -> "OOMKilled"
mike: mike here, i'll take ownership for infra/scale. oncall overlap with sasha, i'll coordinate the scaling and node checks. assigning to me in PD.
mike: scaling emergency: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-worker -n inference --replicas=12` ; also restarting metrics-exporter: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-exporter -n inference`
jen: noted customer impact: support queue shows ~120 open requests referencing slow embeddings. pinging acct teams. sending PSA to affected customers after we stabilize.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: escalated to SRE rotation and second-level page fired.
carla: any ETA? can we set a degraded status on status.redwood.ai?
sasha: current plan: manual scale + restart exporter should restore HPA. if exporter continues OOM we'll revert to previous image tag. ETA ~6-12m to drain backlog once workers come up.
mike: pods coming up. nodes showing image pull ok. `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embeddings-worker` -> 10/12 running, `kubectl top pods -n inference` shows CPU now ~40%.
jen: monitoring: 95th latency down from 12.1s -> 2.4s after scale. queue depth dropping steadily.
carla: support notified customers with interim update: "We’re mitigating elevated embedding latencies in EU. Engineers are on it; next update in 20m." :thumbsup:
sasha: root cause looks like a bad exporter build with memory regression. created follow-up ticket RW-INC-2024 to pin exporter and add OOM alert.
mike: will leave remediation: pin exporter image in k8s manifests and add pod memory limit increase, and add HPA fallback when metrics missing. handing back ownership to sasha for post-incident follow-up.
sasha: ack handback, i'll own the postmortem and runbook updates. thanks all.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: incident resolved (ack cleared) - acknowledged by sasha. Final summary posted to #postmortems and RW-INC-2024 created."
